prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young male food delivery courier stands in the foreground of a modern, cozy café, holding an open insulated delivery bag toward the camera. He wears a yellow and blue windbreaker jacket and a bicycle helmet, his expression neutral and slightly expectant, as if waiting for an order to be placed inside the bag. The café interior is warmly lit with natural daylight streaming through large floor-to-ceiling windows on the right, casting soft shadows and illuminating the wooden floors and furniture. In the background, a few patrons sit at round wooden tables, engaged in quiet conversation or sipping coffee, their figures slightly out of focus to emphasize depth of field. The left wall features a large, whimsical mural in muted earth tones, depicting abstract animals and nature motifs, adding an artistic touch to the space. The overall color palette is warm and inviting, with rich browns, soft yellows, and cool blues. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to keep the courier sharply in focus while gently blurring the background, creating a cinematic, documentary-style atmosphere that captures the everyday intersection of modern urban life and work.
